description.narrative: Programmet stödjer nästa 5-års plan för avrinningsområden i Bolivia (Plan Nacional de Cuencas II) 2013-2017. De viktigaste målen under andra fasen är institutionsuppbyggnad,överföring av ansvar till departements- och kommunal nivå, främjande av planeringsverktyg i förvaltning av avrinningsområden, inklusive de som rör katastrofriskhantering, klimatförändringar och vattenkvalitet.

The program supports the next 5-year plan for river basins in Bolivia (Plan Nacional de Cuenca II) from 2013 to 2017. The main objectives of the second phase are institution building, transfer of responsibilities to the departmental and municipal level, promotion of planning tools in river basin management, including those related to disaster risk management, climate change and water quality.

The support to PNC II is designed to support the consolidation for the national river basin plan (Plan Nacional de Cuencas - PNC II). The program has mechanisms for the planning of water management where stakeholders from different sectors and interest in water use meet and discuss issues and provide suggested solutions. The main objectives of PNC II is institution building and the transfer of responsibility from VRHR (Department of water Resources and irrigation) to municipalities, promotion of territorial planning in the management of river basins, especially those for disaster risk reduction, climate change adaptation and disaster risk reduction is amplified.

description.narrative:
The PNC II during its implementation until 2021 has contributed to promote decentralization and the strengthening of local institutions, including social ones, communication, coordination and cooperation between the different actors, whether governmental or social.
At the micro-basin level, it has been possible to position the basin approach in the management of natural resources and water, although with different degrees of appropriation
The impacts of the implementation of IWRM projects (Integrated Water Resource Management/Gestión Integral de Recursos Hídricos) are evident in the long term, some key actions already show impacts in greater availability of water resources and economic benefits for families (e.g. water harvesting, shortcuts and agro-forestry systems), however, there are no tools to quantify them properly.
At the regional level, the Watershed Plans have contributed to the establishment of intersectoral coordination spaces and the formation of multi-stakeholders Platforms that are an important step towards the solution of the problems presented by the Territorial Entities
On the issue of water quality, the greatest contribution has been its support to generate monitoring and information systems and the institutional strengthening of municipalities in this matter.
Addtiionally, in the current Socio-Economic Development Plan, specific goals and actions of the PNC have been incorporated into national planning. Likewise, Bolivia based its NDCs on the pillars and goals of the Patriotic Agenda and therefore the Socio-Economic Development Plan. This has also been reflected in the PNC. Specifically, Climate Change has been given relevance as an emerging theme, also becoming a component, however, it has tended to focus on actions related to risk management and finding serious problems in activities related to Communication, Coordination and Cooperation.
